_about: Wizards of the Coast era theme decks and the Thunderstorm gift box deck: fixed 60-card lists (written 2026-10-01 from /mnt/project-files/every-era/wotc/research/theme-decks.md, Bulbapedia deck pages with PokeBeach per-set pages as the second source; the two differ by one card (+-1 copy) in Brain Wave, Brock, Dark, Devastation, Electric Garden, Giovanni, Grass Chopper, Light, Trouble, Wallop and the 2-Player CD-ROM starter: the Bulbapedia list is used). Folded into data/box-contents.json by build_box_contents.py (wotc_decks()). Card ids are '<set>-<number>' with the set's own numbered Energy (base1 97-102, base4 125-130, gym1/gym2 127-132, neo1 106-111, ecard1 160-165). Legendary Collection onward the real deck holds one extra random reverse-holo card (61): not modelled, the row is the 60 listed cards. The Thunderstorm deck's basic Energy are listed as plain 'Lightning/Water Energy (TCG)' on Bulbapedia; its note says every card of the North American deck is a Base Set card, so they are the Base Set Energy (base1-100, base1-102): medium confidence. No lists exist in the research for the 2-Player Starter Sets, Trainer Decks A/B or the Demo Game (only a summary of the decks), so they have no rows: never invent a list.
